name: KimokawaE!
source:
In this game, a magical gate has been opened connecting the human world and demon world. Low-class demons have started appearing in the human world due to the dimensional overlap.

You play as a character who must train and discipline these demons during a 30-day summer vacation. As demons have different common sense from humans, they will act strangely without guidance.

If left untrained in human world rules and customs, the demons' influence could strengthen the magical gate and cause further issues. It is up to you to ensure the demons can peacefully live in the human world by the time the gate automatically closes in a month.

You have the duty of training and looking after the demon citizens, teaching them appropriate behavior so they don't endanger themselves or other humans.

[Translated from [url=https://ja.wikipedia.org/wiki/キモかわE!]Japanese Wikipedia[/url]]
translation:
在这款游戏中，连接人类世界和魔界的魔法之门被打开。由于次元重叠，人类世界开始出现低级恶魔。

你扮演的角色必须在30天的暑假里训练和惩戒这些恶魔。由于恶魔与人类有着不同的常识，因此在没有指导的情况下它们会做出奇怪的行为。

如果不遵守人类世界的规则和习俗，恶魔的影响可能会加强魔法之门并引起更多问题。你要确保一个月后大门自动关闭时，恶魔们能够在人间和平地生活。

你有责任训练和照顾恶魔公民，教他们适当的行为，这样他们就不会危及自己或其他人类。

[翻译自[url=https://ja.wikipedia.org/wiki/キモかわE!]日文维基百科[/url]]
